metric: Delta = E[a_i - C_i]; certified via anytime-valid CS on d_i=(a_i-C_i+1)/2 in [0,1]

optional_stopping_plan.description: Item-level anytime-valid CS allows checking after every item without alpha inflation. Simulation: Type-I error under H0 (true gap=0) with peeking at every step should stay <= alpha.

policies.control_reporting: Report the absent-object control and (when run) the spurious-flip specificity control as SEPARATE arms with their own status; a passed intervention gap is not evidence of specificity until the control passes.
policies.exclusion_sensitivity_for_review_uncerta: Define a sensitivity set = items with rater disagreement (IAA gate) OR residual_target_visible in {yes, uncertain}. Recompute the CS with that set dropped; report both. Items are not silently removed from the canonical set.
policies.multiple_model_reporting: Report each model's OWN anytime-valid certified CS. Cross-model agreement is descriptive; do not pool models into a single certified claim. For a joint claim, pre-register a primary model or apply a multiplicity adjustment across the model family.
policies.per_family_analysis: Pre-register the task-family split (support_stability, affordance_reachability, occlusion_safety). Report per-family gaps descriptively; do NOT certify families with tiny n (e.g. occlusion n=6). Certification is at the pooled presence-arm level.

what_not_to_certify: tiny task families (n too small for a meaningful CS)
a single pooled cross-model claim (models are reported individually)
anything via a naive fixed-n confidence interval as the primary claim
specificity, until the spurious-flip control predictions exist and pass
